cleanupPrecedence.normalOrHandled: an error raised by always becomes the current outcome
cleanupPrecedence.recoverablePending: the original error remains primary and the cleanup error is attached as suppressed
cleanupPrecedence.engineFaultPending: the engine fault remains primary and the cleanup error is attached as suppressed

guarantees.cooperativeRuntime: always executes for normal flow, ret, brk, continue, end, recoverable errors, engine faults, timeout and cooperative cancellation
guarantees.processTermination: no cleanup guarantee exists after process termination, operating-system failure or power loss
